description: Unit test class for the ThingPredicateVisitor, testing various predicate filters on Thing objects in Eclipse Ditto framework.

classes.name: ThingPredicateVisitorTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for verifying the behavior of predicate filtering on Thing objects.

methods.name: createCriteria
methods.description: Creates a Criteria object from a filter string using QueryFilterCriteriaFactory.

methods.name: createPredicate
methods.description: Converts a filter string into a Predicate<Thing> via ThingPredicateVisitor.apply.

methods.name: testPredicate
methods.description: Executes assertions to verify if a predicate holds true or false for given Thing objects based on filter criteria.

methods.name: testPredicateNeg
methods.description: Tests that the predicate evaluates to false for the specified non-matching Thing.
